observations.code_quote: lines.push('', 'Store processing may still be pending before these builds become available to testers.', '')
observations.behavior: Adds a warning line in generated GitHub release notes indicating that store review is not complete.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes documentation shown to mobile app users and internal team members reviewing releases. No change to ingestion or delivery.

observations.behavior: Uploads receipt as an attachment and then re-downloads it immediately after upload, comparing both receipts with deep equality check before proceeding.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a runtime safeguard against mismatched receipt content between local state and the published GitHub artifact; failure throws rather than continuing. This could prevent incorrect metadata from advancing production pointers.

observations.behavior: Adds tests asserting that when receipt-related operations fail, the workflow does not advance production and retains staged claims without resubmitting submissions.
observations.posthog_connection: Tests demonstrate recovery behavior: failed receipt handling preserves staging and blocks promotion. Tests do not establish live benefit but support reliability expectations.

observations.limitations: All changes are confined to products/mobile CLI and its fixtures and tests. The implementation adds receipt attachment and checks, but no PostHog backend, database migration, or user-facing API change is demonstrated. Tier 2 requires substantive bounded capability improvement visible in implementation and relevant checks; this group lacks broader system integration and cannot independently establish tier 3. No adoption or incident avoidance can be inferred.

review.limitations: All changes are confined to products/mobile CLI and its fixtures and tests. The implementation adds receipt attachment and checks, but no PostHog backend, database migration, or user-facing API change is demonstrated. Tier 2 requires substantive bounded capability improvement visible in implementation and relevant checks; this group lacks broader system integration and cannot independently establish tier 3. No adoption or incident avoidance can be inferred.
review.reason: The patch demonstrates a concrete correctness and recovery improvement: release notes now include machine-readable receipts as attachments, and publish fails if uploaded receipt differs locally. It also prevents advancement on receipt failures while retaining staged claims. These behaviors are implemented and tested within P1 chunks. However, there is no evidence of wider systemic impact across components or critical paths, so it remains at tier 2 rather than tier 3.
review.posthog_relevance: Could improve mobile release metadata integrity and prevent advancing with mismatched receipts. Benefit depends on downstream consumers using the new attachment and comparison. This chunk alone does not show actual deployment or customer benefit.
review.uncertainty: This chunk omits any production configuration, dependency compatibility, or end-to-end delivery behavior. Without those, we cannot assess real-world benefit or risk reduction beyond CLI safeguards.
